digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch delivery and CAS push mechanics
propositions: Duplicate CAS push and retry loops scattered across workflows are consolidated into a single Python core module that owns all push-first retry, fetch-and-merge recovery, and five-cycle budgeting.
The strict push delivery contract raises typed PushDeliveryError with reason, detail, and unpushed-commit count, while best-effort default is preserved for existing Python library and MCP callers.
Workflow adapters delegate delivery once through locked Python entrypoints (commit-and-push for bridge, push adapter for canary) instead of maintaining their own fetch/merge/retry loops.
All three workflow cutovers and core implementation changes are merged and verified, with exhausted strict delivery producing nonzero adapter exit code visible to GitHub Actions.
Existing CLI, library, MCP, importer, and ticket-store callers retain backward compatibility through best-effort defaults and unchanged return/disposition contracts.
No persisted ticket schema, event vocabulary, or installation path changed; rollback requires reverting workflows before reverting the strict Python entrypoints.
